• ARROWGREEN (Presentations & PR): Executive Summary: Arrow Greentech Limited Q1 FY27 Performance Arrow Greentech Ltd. delivered exceptional Q1 FY27 financial performance, reporting over 110% Q-o-Q and Y-o-Y revenue growth, coupled with a remarkable 269% Q-o-Q surge in Profit After Tax and significant margin expansion (PAT margin at 30.5%).
